Voter deletion row centers on Karnataka, BJP leaders booked

A controversy surrounding alleged attempts to delete voters has emerged in Karnataka, with BJP leaders being booked in connection with bulk applications submitted through Form 7. The Election Commission (EC) stated it would take action against such applications. Reports indicate that a single constituency in Jharkhand accounts for over a third of voter deletion requests nationally. Meanwhile, voter roll revision in Keralam is proceeding differently amidst the ongoing "SIR row". Parakala Prabhakar has commented on the Election Commission of India (ECI), SIR, and voter deletions.
